purpose: Define the earliest boundary from which future collection completeness may be verified. This record does not prove or restore earlier Kafka history.

repository.head: 64a713c4edcd65b6187f1fbf330c2666a594ceaf
repository.note: The uncommitted change adds the timezone dependency required by the read-only audit. Freeze a clean revision before the first post-baseline collection session.

research_scope.final_paper_evaluation_eligible_from_off: Use each partition's post_baseline_start_offset, subject to later eligibility, annotation, grouping and freeze gates.
research_scope.excluded_history: Kafka delivery completeness before this boundary is unknown. GDELT offsets below 50 and SEC offsets below 106 are no longer retained and have no writer-group commit evidence.

activation_gate.basis: Baseline-aware drain tests cover clean completion, no-new-record partitions, writer lag, pending delivery, offset and commit regression, retention overtaking an unprocessed writer, and partition-set changes. A live broker check is required before the first verified collection session.
activation_gate.limitation: Activation makes later transport ranges verifiable; it does not make pre-baseline records eligible or complete collection-session provenance.
